Carry out the following instructions referring to Fig. 1.1 and Fig. 1.2.

The pendulum has been set up for you. Do not adjust the position of the clamp supporting
the pendulum.

parts.label: a
parts.text:
Measure and record in Table 1.1 the vertical distance d from the floor to the bottom of
the pendulum bob.

content.html: Measure and record in Table 1.1 the vertical distance d from the floor to the bottom of the pendulum bob.
content.text: Measure and record in Table 1.1 the vertical distance d from the floor to the bottom of the pendulum bob.

parts.label: b
parts.text:
Displace the pendulum bob slightly and release it so that it swings. Measure and record
in Table 1.1 the time t for 20 complete oscillations of the pendulum (see Fig. 1.2).

content.html: Displace the pendulum bob slightly and release it so that it swings. Measure and record in Table 1.1 the time t for 20 complete oscillations of the pendulum (see Fig. 1.2).
content.text: Displace the pendulum bob slightly and release it so that it swings. Measure and record in Table 1.1 the time t for 20 complete oscillations of the pendulum (see Fig. 1.2).

parts.label: c
parts.text:
Calculate the period T of the pendulum. The period is the time for one complete
oscillation.  Record the value of T in Table 1.1.

content.html: Calculate the period T of the pendulum. The period is the time for one complete oscillation. Record the value of T in Table 1.1.
content.text: Calculate the period T of the pendulum. The period is the time for one complete oscillation. Record the value of T in Table 1.1.

parts.label: d
parts.text:
Without changing the position of the clamp supporting the pendulum, adjust the length
until the vertical distance d from the floor to the bottom of the pendulum bob is about
20 cm. Measure and record in Table 1.1 the actual value of d to the nearest 0.1 cm.
Repeat steps (b) and (c).
